record_title: Exact spherical-harmonic Hessian and instability index for the Gaussian volume product
limitations: This is a second-variation theorem for smooth support-function perturbations. It does not settle the global maximization gap for n>=3, does not assert a uniform infinite-dimensional nonlinear local maximum, and does not determine higher-order behavior at the critical translation modes. The motivating preprint is very recent, so unindexed parallel work remains possible.
